description: Source code for system management commands in the Mattermost CLI, including commands for server status, version, busy state, and support packet generation.

methods.name: getBusyCmdF
methods.description: Fetches and displays the server's busy state and expiration timestamp.

methods.name: setBusyCmdF
methods.description: Sets the server busy state for a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: clearBusyCmdF
methods.description: Clears the server busy state, re-enabling non-critical services.

methods.name: systemVersionCmdF
methods.description: Fetches and displays the server version.

methods.name: systemStatusCmdF
methods.description: Fetches and displays the server status, including health checks for database and filestore.

methods.name: systemSupportPacketCmdF
methods.description: Downloads a support packet from the server and saves it to a specified file.
